name: gov-interop-platform
description: Cross-department interoperability framework: centralized document vault, 4 sample government portals, MCP connectors, and a unified government services chatbot.

scripts.seed: npm run seed -w @govstack/document-vault-api && npm run seed -w @govstack/portal-aadhar && npm run seed -w @govstack/portal-pan && npm run seed -w @govstack/portal-gas && npm run seed -w @govstack/portal-electricity
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n VAULT-API,VAULT-WEB,AADHAR,PAN,GAS,ELECTRICITY,CHATBOT-API,CHATBOT-WEB -c blue,cyan,green,yellow,magenta,red,white,gray "npm run dev -w @govstack/document-vault-api" "npm run dev -w @govstack/document-vault-web" "npm run dev -w @govstack/portal-aadhar" "npm run dev -w @govstack/portal-pan" "npm run dev -w @govstack/portal-gas" "npm run dev -w @govstack/portal-electricity" "npm run dev -w @govstack/chatbot-api" "npm run dev -w @govstack/chatbot-web"
scripts.dev:portals: concurrently -k -n AADHAR,PAN,GAS,ELECTRICITY -c green,yellow,magenta,red "npm run dev -w @govstack/portal-aadhar" "npm run dev -w @govstack/portal-pan" "npm run dev -w @govstack/portal-gas" "npm run dev -w @govstack/portal-electricity"
scripts.dev:vault: concurrently -k -n VAULT-API,VAULT-WEB -c blue,cyan "npm run dev -w @govstack/document-vault-api" "npm run dev -w @govstack/document-vault-web"
scripts.dev:chatbot: concurrently -k -n CHATBOT-API,CHATBOT-WEB -c white,gray "npm run dev -w @govstack/chatbot-api" "npm run dev -w @govstack/chatbot-web"
